Directions.title: What do you need English for?
Directions.intro: Do not pick a course at random. Start with the outcome — we will account for your level, deadline and preferred format.

GoalMatcher.title: Find your starting point.
GoalMatcher.intro: Choose one goal now. We will keep it in the link so you can continue from it in the short enquiry form.
GoalMatcher.question: What matters most to you?
GoalMatcher.emptyValue: Choose a goal on the right
GoalMatcher.emptyNote: This does not lock you into a programme — the final plan depends on your level and deadline.
GoalMatcher.selectedNote: Your choice is saved. We will use it to match the programme in the next step.
GoalMatcher.privacyNote: No contact details are needed at this step.

Formats.title: Clear before the first conversation.
Formats.intro: Choose the level of personalisation and budget that suit you. The programme within each format is adapted to your goal.
Formats.examNote: NMT, EVI and international exam preparation uses the same formats and the standard price of the format you choose.
